title: Long-haul DOM invariant sweep — the committed wide run (5 seeds x 35 in-game days)
gameCommitSubject: T-199: F-150-2: `smugglerPolicy`'s unguarded Explore loop, and the shared `planPacifistCombat` stall behind it
note: Every run below was driven entirely through the real DOM — real clicks on the real cockpit in real Chromium, no `applyPlayerAction` from the test, no state injection. The battery in packages/ui/e2e/support/longhaul-invariants.ts ran after EVERY dispatched step; `checksRun` is `steps x 8` by construction and is asserted, not narrated. This file is a hand-copied snapshot of packages/ui/test-results/longhaul/ (gitignored, per the T-155 / T-1604a precedent); the per-file sha256 lets a re-run be compared.

invariants.name: inv_no_uncaught_exception

invariants.claim: the step logged no console error (no allowlist — real noise is a finding, not a filter)
